top_signals.title: New human-machine interface will help Boxer punch above its weight

top_signals.title: Incat Crowther to Build Fourth Fast Support Intervention Vessel
top_signals.summary: Offshore energy services provider Zamil Offshore has commissioned global digital shipbuilder IncatCrowther and Singaporean shipbuilder Lita Ocean to design, build and deliver a fourth 60-meter ABS-Classed monohull Fast Support Intervention Vessel (FSIV).
